description: What scripts/rule check does with its findings. report (the first pass ordered by Daniel on 2026-10-28): print every count, exit 0. refuse: exit 1 when a stopping record has a gap, an unanswered question, no measurement or no root cause for the stops it counted, a stopping function has no record (a stop without a question), a retirement lacks its recorded decision, or a record left rules.catalog without one (--base). Flipped only by an approved decision, in the change that retires R-rule-record-complete for a stopping record.
x-source: D-072; D-069 item 9 (Daniel's order of 2026-10-28 16:52 and 16:55 BRT, RULE-AUDIT)
